title: sorghum caffrorum
intro: Sorghum caffrorum, commonly known as African sorghum, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, due to its richness in fiber, vitamins, and minerals. The therapeutic actions of Sorghum caffrorum include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
